currentUserGoal: Enable a compact mobile minimap that helps the player see where they are without obscuring the play field.
changesMade: Allowed the world map/minimap to render in mobile portrait when the board is pannable or the field is large enough to need location context.
Made the mobile minimap read-only by disabling its hit zone and guarding drag/key handlers in mobile portrait, so board gestures remain reserved for the play field.
Sized the mobile minimap to a compact 66-76 px range, removed its title/header treatment on mobile, lowered opacity, and anchored it inside the board's top-right corner.
Kept desktop/tablet world map rail behavior unchanged by only reserving the side rail outside mobile portrait.
verification: Mobile stress visual check at http://127.0.0.1:5173/?stress&perf&tiles=1200&v=mobile-minimap-2 using 390x844 viewport: minimap was visible, small, read-only, and did not cover the main playable area heavily.
Mobile perf harness at http://127.0.0.1:5173/?perfHarness&tiles=1200&v=mobile-minimap-harness completed all phases.

Perf harness notable fields: idle visibleTiles 15, layoutPasses 0, redraws 0, redrawQueued 0, maxFrameDeltaMs 12, frameSpikes 0, displayObjects 174, activeTweens 17; complete visibleTiles 12, layoutPasses 0, redraws 0, redrawQueued 0, maxFrameDeltaMs 7, frameSpikes 0, displayObjects 222, activeTweens 22.
Browser console warning/error log was empty.

untrackedLeftAlone: docs/Strategieen voor Geavanceerde Automatisering in Incrementele Games.md

knownIssues: The mobile startup/loading green-screen feel and quest-log mobile performance are separate optimization targets from this minimap pass.
A stress-view startup sample can still show a brief low-fps first layout spike; the repeatable harness was stable after the board initialized.
nextRecommendedSteps: Push this commit live for mobile testing.
Profile the quest log on a phone viewport next, especially scroll handling, text/object counts, and overlay touch capture.
Profile startup with a cold load and identify what runs before the first meaningful board paint.
doNotRevert: Do not restore the old mobile condition that hid the world map entirely in portrait.
Do not make the mobile minimap interactive unless it is proven not to intercept board pan/zoom gestures.
